question: What youthful form of sixteen years results from constant yogic practice?
premises: A form of sixteen years is specified
This form comes to be as a result
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is interpreted as sixteen-year form but could be read differently
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
